context: WrestleMania 42 Night 1 — annual flagship PLE. 7 matches. Corrective card after WM41's fractured Night 2.

segments.outcome: Usos and LA Knight defeated Logan Paul, Austin Theory, and iShowSpeed. Post-match Logan attacked iShowSpeed; Usos and Knight saved Speed. Speed delivered Logan's frog splash through the announce table — crowd-endorsed initiation.
segments.notes: False Gods corrected on third consecutive WrestleMania. iShowSpeed's table spot = real initiation; chaos-streamer crossed from civilian to performer. Adoption-into-collective motif (Waller/New Day, Mateo/MFTs pattern).

segments.outcome: Jacob Fatu defeated Drew McIntyre in an Unsanctioned match. A war.
segments.notes: Feral-sovereign confirmed at the highest stage. Aitu-vs-Wotan resolved — Drew's containment arc ends. Fatu's credential established for WHC challenge.

segments.outcome: Brie Bella and surprise returning Paige (substituting for injured Nikki Bella) won Women's Tag Fatal 4-Way. Paige had been told she would never wrestle again. Alexa entered as black/white moth; Charlotte as colorful butterfly.
segments.notes: Dioscuri twin-mirror shattered by Nikki injury; replaced by underworld-return narrative. Paige = Persephone returning from injury exile. Bliss/Flair loss frees Alexa for Sister Abigail latency. The moment belonged to the return, not the victory.

segments.outcome: Becky Lynch defeated AJ Lee to win the Women's Championship. AJ's entrance featured a dozen young girls in pink. Becky won clean.
segments.notes: Nemesis over Persephone. 11-year underworld return not honored — system chose consequence over sentiment. AJ received the flowers (crowd ovation); Becky received the gold.

segments.outcome: Gunther retained the World Heavyweight Championship via Bron Breakker interference. Post-match, Breakker walked up the ramp to Paul Heyman — alliance confirmed. Heyman's new enforcer revealed.
segments.notes: Kronos survived via institutional reinforcement, not his own strength. Breakker as next-gen enforcer protecting current-gen tyrant. Heyman/Breakker = the loaded gun for Night 2. Rollins/Gunther unresolved — correction pressure carries forward.

segments.outcome: Liv Morgan defeated Stephanie Vaquer to win the Women's Championship. Judgment Day interference failed — Liv won despite the assist, not because of it. Inanna completed the return on her own terms.
segments.notes: Inanna's descent-and-return completes. Rumble-to-Mania investment honored. The dark-feminine coven tried to force the outcome and the myth overrode it. Hekate loses the threshold.

segments.outcome: Bianca Belair announced her pregnancy live at WrestleMania 42. Montez Ford with her. The arena celebrated.
segments.notes: Night 1's only pure shoot. The system that scripts everything encountered something it cannot script. Artemis-competitive brand shifts publicly toward Isis-maternal. Irreducibly real inside a ritual space.

segments.outcome: Cody Rhodes defeated Randy Orton to retain the Undisputed WWE Championship. Jelly Roll elbow-dropped Pat McAfee mid-match; McAfee carted out on stretcher. Cody finished clean.
segments.notes: Telemachus holds the kingdom across three consecutive WrestleManias (WM40 finish the story, WM41 survived Cena extraction, WM42 defeats manufactured challenge). Anubis-Judge weighed the heart and was found wanting. Punt kick gave Cody the orbital fracture he carried into post-Mania.
